headline: Anthropic launches Claude Fable 5; Enslaved God climbs
body: Anthropic released Claude Fable 5, its first generally available Mythos-class model, claiming state-of-the-art results on nearly all benchmarks, such as 80.3% on SWE-Bench Pro against 58.6% for GPT-5.5. A version with cyber safeguards lifted, Mythos 5, went only to Project Glasswing partners. A leap in Capability Velocity, held by one company, also raises Power Concentration. That is the recipe for Enslaved God, a powerful AI kept under one owner's control, and it lifted Zookeeper and Descendants too. Taiwan is weighing curbs on AI chip exports to all Chinese customers, which strains Global Coordination and trims Gatekeeper. Apple and the EU clashed over Siri AI not launching in Europe. Horizon Balance fell 0.16 to 2.3.
movers_note: Enslaved God +0.5, from the Fable 5 launch (+0.56) minus Taiwan's chip-curb news; Zookeeper +0.4 from Fable 5 (+0.43); Reversion -0.3, as the Fable 5 launch signalled faster progress (-0.35).
